'''0761''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who was stationed on [[Ciutric IV]] one [[5 ABY/Legends|year]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Evacuation of Ciutric|attacked]] Ciutric in an attempt to free [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a minor skirmish outside of [[Daplona]] when a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] member of [[Commando Team One]] snapped their neck from behind.<ref name="Rogue Squadron 34" />
